title: The 12 best free writing software in 2026
summary: Whether you're trying to come up with a new idea, weave together a jumble of ideas, or write without distractions, these free writing apps can help.
body_markdown:
**Best for**


**Standout feature**


MindMeister


Mind mapping


Real-time collaboration and integration with MeisterTask


Miro


Brainstorming together


Supports mind maps, Kanban boards, and virtual sticky notes


Google Keyword Planner


Brainstorming topics backed by keyword research


Keyword Ideas tab surfaces niche topics by relevance


Wispr Flow


Brainstorming out loud


Detects which app you're in and adapts tone (professional vs. casual)


Notion


Keeping everything in one place


All-in-one features for writing and project management


Google Docs


Solo and collaborative writing


Comments and version history help you track what changes were made by who and when


FocusWriter


Focused writing


Full-screen writing mode with customizable themes and a timer for writing sprints


Merriam-Webster


Finding the perfect word


Offers simplified definitions for plain-language clarity


Hemingway Editor


Clear and concise writing


Assigns your writing a readability score


GPTZero


Comparing your writing to AI content


Detection model shields can catch bypassing approaches (like paraphrasing)


Grammarly


Proofreading


Browser extension checks your writing across every app
